Paneer Tikka Sandwich

A classic paneer sandwich recipe to beat your kid’s random hunger pangs!

5 minPreparation
10 minCooking
1Servings

Ingredients

For 1 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Heat the oil in a pan; add the chopped onions and fry until they turn pink.
  2. Add the ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, garam masala and salt, and mix well.
  3. Add the paneer and mix gently. Sauté until the spices coat the paneer.
  4. Spread a little butter on a slice of bread. Top with 2 tablespoons of the paneer mixture. Cover with another slice of bread.
  5. Cook Kissan Paneer Tikka Sandwich on both sides on a tawa, or grill until golden and crisp.
